component: Calendar event create Save unit tests

quotes.text: Please separate out complex calls from assertions
The current assertion contains an awaited Save call, an options object, and a callback. A local result makes the tested action and expected status easier to locate.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: In D332899 at revision 3e22f6ce2506a323aecd485c174f9dab1c3a0298, a reviewer explicitly requested separating complex calls from assertions in test_calendarEventCreateSave.js. The proposed change stores awaited Save results in local variables so the action and expected status are easier to locate, while preserving sequential execution. The AI reports 115 passing assertions. The prepared change was not accepted; this is a reviewer request for this test, not an established Thunderbird-wide convention.
title: Separate complex Save actions from assertions
